channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kendrick Perkins | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kendrick Perkins from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Glen Davis on Kendrick Perkins, Darius Miles, Tony Allen
item.description:
“Kendrick Perkins, you see him on ESPN. Tony Allen—he was literally the third person on the indictment, with his wife. He's not walking in jail. Darius Miles—he's not walking in jail. And these guys got money, like thousands of dollars. How'd I end up in jail and these guys are on probation/walking free; their whole life is still intact. “I think the NBA let the feds pick who they wanted to choose. 180 people were investigated/supenoed. We didn't hear about all those people. We just heard about the 22 people that got caught, or that got jammed in the situation. A lot of people pleaded out. They didn't go to jail. They didn't even go get time served.”

Glen Davis on Kendrick Perkins, Darius Miles, Tony Allen, Sep 5, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Kendrick Perkins, Stephen A. Smith
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“Let's just stop with the anonymous sources. Chat, the anonymous sources is crazy. Him saying that executive and a scout, that said these things in an anonymous source, Stephen A. Smith saying an anonymous source, Kendrick Perkins saying an anonymous source, or somebody texting, likewhat is with these people and these anonymous sources, bro? They don't see how unethical that is and just stating that on live TV. It's like somebody saying a rumor in front of millions of people and not even taking in the account that amount of damage that rumor could do. But they don't even know if it's true or not. It's just a source.”

Jaylen Brown on Kendrick Perkins, Stephen A. Smith, Jul 3, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Sam Presti on Kendrick Perkins
item.description:
Sam Presti on Kendrick Perkins:

“Perk really is a unique figure in our history. He changed a lot of things when he got here. I think he won like 75% of the games he played here. Which is an astounding stat. He did have some pretty good teammates. He helped us go from a fun team to a contending team.”

Sam Presti on Kendrick Perkins, Jun 30, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Marcin Gortat on Kendrick Perkins, Dennis Rodman
item.description:
“I became a better screener by watching guys like Kendrick Perkins, Dennis Rodman,”

Marcin Gortat on Kendrick Perkins, Dennis Rodman, May 5, 2017. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Anthony Davis on Kendrick Perkins
item.description:
Sirius XM NBA:Anthony Davis:

“I'm glad to have guys like (Kendrick Perkins) to help me be a leader.”

Anthony Davis on Kendrick Perkins, Feb 12, 2016. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.

item.title: Alvin Gentry on Kendrick Perkins
item.description:
Royce Young:Alvin Gentry on Kendrick Perkins:

“As long as I'm the coach, I'd want to keep him around.”

Alvin Gentry on Kendrick Perkins, Nov 19, 2015. Source: Twitter @royceyoung.

item.title: Chris Webber on Kendrick Perkins
item.description:
Anthony Slater:Chris Webber on Perkins' role with Cavs:

“He has a role like my grandfather. When my granddaddy was around, everybody was serious business.”

Chris Webber on Kendrick Perkins, Apr 3, 2015. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Sam Presti on Kendrick Perkins
item.description:
Darnell Mayberry:Sam Presti on Kendrick Perkins:

“I think he's going to go back and work and COME BACK improved.”

Sam Presti on Kendrick Perkins, May 18, 2013. Source: Twitter @DarnellMayberry.

item.title: Kevin Garnett on Kendrick Perkins, Nate Robinson, Jermaine O'Neal
item.description:
Kevin Garnett:

“The team with Shaq, Bib Baby, Kendrick Perkins, Jermaine O'Neal, Nate Robinson... That was probably the most fun I've had since I've been in the league... That team was a character. [...] There was never a dull moment in that locker room. I wish we got Shaq earlier in his career... That was a cool team.”

Kevin Garnett on Kendrick Perkins, Nate Robinson, Jermaine O'Neal, Sep 10, 2012. Source: YouTube.

item.title: LeBron James on Kendrick Perkins
item.description:
Shortly after the dunk, James tweeted,

“Dunk of the Year! @blakegriffin just dunked on Kendrick Perkins so hard!!! Wow! I guess I’m No. 2 now. Move over #6.”

LeBron James on Kendrick Perkins, Feb 8, 2012. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Sam Presti on Kendrick Perkins
item.description:
Evaluating the trade for Kendrick Perkins now that the season is over:Sam Presti:

“Obviously when you make a trade like that you’re making it for a lot of different reasons. … It was a chance to not only get a player who understands the finer points of the games, understands how high-performing teams work, especially the defensive end. But to get someone like that, at that position, at 26 years old, was something we were very excited about. … We know and we knew when we made the trade that he was on pace in his recovery but he wasn’t going to be 100 percent. … You never heard Kendrick complain or make an excuse that, although he was deep into his rehab, it wasn’t completed. We like the fact that his standards never changed.”

Sam Presti on Kendrick Perkins, May 31, 2011. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.

item.title: Wyc Grousbeck on Jeff Green, Kendrick Perkins
item.description:
Wyc Grousbeck on the Kendrick Perkins trade:

“I love Perk, but I don't think our issue was guarding the 5-spot. Our issue was guarding their 2, 3, 4. So not only did we need Jeff Green, we needed about 3 more of him.”

Wyc Grousbeck on Jeff Green, Kendrick Perkins, May 26, 2011. Source: CSNNE.com.

item.title: Tyson Chandler on Kendrick Perkins
item.description:
The one thing the centers agreed on was that they wouldn't allow the intensity of their individual matchup to cause them to lose composure.

“Honestly, my motive is not to get into it with Kendrick Perkins,”

Tyson Chandler on Kendrick Perkins, May 19, 2011. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Sam Presti on Kendrick Perkins
item.description:
general manager Sam Presti said in a statement.

“We are pleased to know that he will be a part of our core group now and in the future. Kendrick's blue-collar, team-first approach aligns with the vision we hold for building a sustainable team in the Oklahoma City community.”

Sam Presti on Kendrick Perkins, Mar 1, 2011. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Kendrick Perkins
item.description:
“That's the nature of it, man. It's kinda bittersweet 'cuz we're getting a great guy in Kendrick, and also Nate and Nazr. But to lose D.J., Nenad, Jeff and Mo Pete - guys I really loved in this locker room - it's gonna be tough for us,but we just gotta lean on each other for support and we'll be alright.”

Kevin Durant on Kendrick Perkins, Feb 26, 2011. Source: HoopsWorld.

item.title: Dwight Howard on Kendrick Perkins
item.description:
Asked early this afternoon how the trade of Perkins would affect a potential Magic-Celtics playoff series, Howard responded,

“Kendrick was out almost the whole season. They had the second-best record in the NBA.”

Dwight Howard on Kendrick Perkins, Feb 25, 2011. Source: Orlando Sentinel.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Kendrick Perkins
item.description:
Doc Rivers on his message to Lakers fan Doc Walker:

“Number one you gotta congratulate them because they won. They still have not beaten our starting five. Our starting five against the Lakers starting five has a ring. Tell him don’t forget that. We will be back strong and Perk (Kendrick Perkins) will be there next year if there’s a game seven.”

Doc Rivers on Kendrick Perkins, Aug 23, 2010. Source: Sports Radio Interviews.
